rules.ar: Use the Clipverb app's own labels exactly: "Captions only" is "التسميات فقط"; "Captions + distill" is "التسميات + التلخيص"; "Browser fetcher" is "جالب المتصفح"; "Copy pairing code" is "نسخ رمز الإقران"; "Pairing code" is "رمز الإقران". Keep "clipverb.app", "127.0.0.1" and "Obsidian" as written.
rules.es: Use the Clipverb app's own labels exactly: "Captions only" is "Solo subtítulos"; "Captions + distill" is "Subtítulos + resumen"; "Browser fetcher" is "Recuperador del navegador"; "Copy pairing code" is "Copiar código de vinculación"; "Pairing code" is "Código de vinculación". Keep "clipverb.app", "127.0.0.1" and "Obsidian" as written.
rules.fr: Use the Clipverb app's own labels exactly: "Captions only" is "Sous-titres uniquement"; "Captions + distill" is "Sous-titres + résumé"; "Browser fetcher" is "Récupérateur de navigateur"; "Copy pairing code" is "Copier le code d'association"; "Pairing code" is "Code d'association". Keep "clipverb.app", "127.0.0.1" and "Obsidian" as written.
rules.all: These are the interface strings of an Obsidian plugin that sends a video link to the Clipverb desktop app. Short, plain, second person. Never call the app or a mode free.
